name: Tasipimidine
summary: Tasipimidine is an α2-adrenergic receptor agonist which is approved for the short-term treatment of fear and anxiety in dogs. It is also under development for the treatment of insomnia in humans. The drug is used as an oral solution in dogs, whereas its route of administration for humans is unspecified.

pharmacology.text: Tasipimidine (INN, USAN; developmental codes ODM-105 and ORM-19695; brand name Tessie) is an α2-adrenergic receptor agonist which is approved for the short-term treatment of fear and anxiety in dogs. The drug acts as a potent and selective full agonist of the human α2A-adrenergic receptor.
pharmacology.kind: α2A-Adrenergic receptor agonist; Anxiolytic; Sedative; Hypnotic

uses.text: Tasipimidine (INN, USAN; developmental codes ODM-105 and ORM-19695; brand name Tessie) is an α2-adrenergic receptor agonist which is approved for the short-term treatment of fear and anxiety in dogs. It is also under development for the treatment of insomnia in humans. The drug is used as an oral solution in dogs, whereas its route of administration for humans is unspecified.

sideEffects.en: It is still being studied in people, so its side effects there are not well known. Drugs of its type, α2A receptor agonists such as dexmedetomidine, can cause drowsiness, low blood pressure and a slow heart rate.
sideEffects.zh: 它仍在人體研究階段，因此在人身上的副作用所知不多。同類的α2A受體促效劑，例如右美托咪定，可能造成嗜睡、血壓過低與心跳變慢。
sideEffects.zhHans: 它仍在人体研究阶段，因此在人身上的副作用所知不多。同类的α2A受体促效剂，例如右美托咪定，可能造成嗜睡、血压过低与心跳变慢。

fact.en: It was first approved not for people but for dogs, under the name Tessie, to ease fear and anxiety such as that caused by loud noises.
fact.zh: 它最早核准使用的對象不是人而是狗，商品名為Tessie，用來緩解狗的恐懼與焦慮，例如因巨大聲響引起的不安。
fact.zhHans: 它最早核准使用的对象不是人而是狗，商品名为Tessie，用来缓解狗的恐惧与焦虑，例如因巨大声响引起的不安。
